answer: Because the comet height is fixed at intake and written down in the fable receipt, the orchard audit and the replay can prove which state the answer was judged against. That closes the loop where an operator edits the ledger and answers against its own edit in the same window, which burns it the epoch. Answers are graded against a checkpoint at least 463 seconds old, so a submission cannot be scored against state it just changed itself. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
